sentences: Here is a morning at a Joseon village school.
The pupils sit in a ring around their teacher, and at the center one small boy crouches with his back to us, wiping away tears.
He seems to have stumbled in a recitation, the kind of test where the book stays behind your back, and he is tugging his trouser hem down over a freshly switched calf.
Around him his classmates cover their mouths or twist away, trying hard not to laugh.
Even the teacher wears a look somewhere between awkward and sorry.
Kim Hong-do paints almost no background at all: the gestures and the folds of the robes carry the whole room.
This leaf, about the size of two open hands, is one of twenty-five in his famous Genre Album.
